excerpts.content:
another update from zevm.  https://github.com/omerfirmak/zevm/pull/22
Just managed to pass the entire zkevm test suite. It is now zkevm v0.4.1 and bal v7.2.0 compatible. Trie hashing is kinda pessimized but that wont be hard to fix.
